name: Storefront and warehouse — external write reload persistence
note: A self-contained supporting probe. It performs its own direct database write before reloading, so it can be selected or rerun without depending on the live-propagation check.

features.name: A direct database write survives reload

criteria.desc: after a direct database write sets Desk Lamp's East stock to 5, a reload reads the persisted total of 50
criteria.note: Supporting evidence for 901a rather than a second score. It rules out a page-only patch but has no distinct calibrated failure mode.
criteria.statedBy: when data changes by a path its server never saw
